**gate-info-address-tracker v1.0.1 Changelog**

- Added update management scripts (`scripts/update-skill.sh`) and update policy documentation, improving version-checking and user flow for skill updates.
- SKILL.md: Substantially expanded and clarified runtime and update rules, including agent-specific blocking flows for confirming or declining updates.
- Added a technical reference document (`references/mcp.md`).
- Updated documentation files (README.md, SKILL.md, CHANGELOG.md) to reflect new update-handling procedures and stricter runtime requirements.
- No changes to core tracking/analysis logic or MCP tool calls; this is a procedural and compliance update.

Initial release of gate-info-addresstracker — an on-chain address tracker and analysis skill.

- Detects and analyzes on-chain addresses provided by the user, covering ETH, BTC, TRX, and more.
- Supports both simple address queries (profile, holdings, risk) and deeper tracking (large transactions, fund flows).
- Automatic detection of address type and recommended workflows (basic or deep) based on user intent and address characteristics.
- Provides comprehensive, templated reports including risk analysis, DeFi positions, PnL, major transactions, and fund tracing.
- Includes robust intent recognition/routing for related topics (risk check, token behavior, whale watching, etc.).
- Adaptive thresholds on report detail based on address size and apparent risk level.
